treatment.subject: Size manual-orchestration packets by their read set

instrument.action: ~/.claude/skills/manual-orchestration replaced with a symlink to skills/manual-orchestration
instrument.verified: diff -rq between the two paths reports no differences; worker.md and coordinator.md digests now agree
instrument.sibling_sweep: 10 other skills present in both ~/.claude/skills and skills/ compared; all byte-identical, so manual-orchestration was the only divergence

cohort_rule.pre_change: builder read the reference text before 2026-10-22T01:59:50Z
cohort_rule.post_change: builder read it after, AND recorded the digest of what it read
cohort_rule.note: R1 could not apply the second clause, which is why R1-M-001 went unnoticed

instance.note: declared a handoff having written nothing

H1.claim: context at first code write falls
H1.confounded_by: the treatment also says commit after each passing unit, which moves the first write earlier without reducing reading

H2.claim: no builder spends a whole context without writing code

H5.registered_as: secondary; treatment does not target it; no effect is the expected result

disambiguation_rule: A fall in H1 with pre_write_read_calls unchanged against B6 is earlier committing, not leaner reading, and must be reported as such. Only a fall in both supports the reading claim.

held_constant.trigger_question: whether 150000 is too conservative is campaign R3, not R2; the lowest auto-compaction observed on this machine is 202533 and two of four R1 handoffs fired below the trigger
held_constant.handoff_mechanism: parent-mediated: handoff file plus handoff_ready, coordinator launches the successor on it

requirements_for_scorability: at least two Rust-building slices of 2000-5000 added Rust lines each
every worker records the sha256 of each reference file it actually read
each packet states its read set, and the slice record states how many lines that read set comprises
context checks at each phase boundary with input_tokens, recommendation and trigger
branch, commit range and net added lines per language recorded at the end
confounds: between-campaign: R2 builds a different subject, so pre-write reading must be normalised per 1k lines the read set comprises
small n: R1 contributes 7 pre-change builders over 2 code slices; every claim carries its n
reviewers are inside the orchestration being measured; the only outside check is a direct gate re-run
instrument change: the symlink removes a confound but is itself a difference between R1 and R2

the measurement role shares a branch with the subject; R1's integration base moved because this role committed mid-decision. For R2 hold measurement commits until integration lands, or use a separate branch
out_of_scope: comparison with pure-Codex on handoff behaviour: Codex has no context-replacement primitive, so the arms differ in capability not only instruction
Plus-unit or quota claims; weighted tokens are the only common unit
